verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an extensive API (access tokens, webhooks, plugin API) and a first-party MCP server that was runtime-verified to work self-hosted, giving AI-native builders real hooks into design data and workflows. However, there's no evidence of dedicated official client SDKs (e.g., typed Python/JS libraries) and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s on multiple candidate paths) or llms.txt, suggesting the 'SDK' story is served by raw API/plugin docs rather than packaged SDKs. Missing for 10: published OpenAPI/spec files, official language-specific SDK packages, and independent developer reports building against these SDKs.
